name: stats-band
title: Stats band
description: A hairline-separated band of headline numbers: throughput, accuracy, uptime.

standards.purpose: Make one row of real numbers unforgettable.
useWhen: Three to five real metrics deserve a band of their own.
doNotUseWhen: The numbers are estimates or goals — never present projections as results.

rules.check: Every stat states a measured value with its unit; no invented metrics.
